description_expanded: OverviewHot TubSeagrove Beach- Public Beach - 3 Minute Bike Ride, Community Pool and Tennis, 3 Bikes Included `Luce Del Sol`The SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Easy Keyless Check-in – Personalized lock code for stress-free access. 24/7 Concierge Service – Support whenever you need it! 2 Community Swimming Pools – Relax & cool off (no pool heat available). 2 Community Tennis/Pickleball Courts – Newly resurfaced for ultimate fun! 3 FREE Bikes – Explore Seagrove Beach & 30A in style! Nature Trails – Stroll scenic trails, feed the fish & turtles! Free Wi-Fi – Stay connected & stream your favorites. Flat Screen TVs – In the living room & all bedrooms for entertainment. 2 Parking Spaces – Convenient spots right behind the house. Beach Essentials – Umbrellas, chairs, & kids’ beach/pool toys included! Outdoor Shower – Rinse off sandy feet after a fun beach day!Welcome to Luce Del SolNestled in the quiet, sought-after Cassine Village, this newly renovated single-level home has been completely transformed with GE Café appliances and luxury designer touches throughout — coastal living, elevated for your family to enjoy. ________________________________________The SpaceNearly 1,500 sq ft of beautifully designed living space for up to 8 guests:• Master Bedroom — King-size bed with private en-suite bathroom• Bedroom 2 — Queen-size bed• Bedroom 3 — Two double bedsThe designer eat-in kitchen features a full GE Café appliance suite and seating for 10 — perfect for cooking up fresh catch from nearby Goatfeathers Seafood. Gather on the covered front porch, screened-in back patio or spacious living/dining great room, to unwind and enjoy the beach vibes. ________________________________________Walk to the Best of 30A • Seagrove Beach — 7 minute walk• Greenway Station (restaurants, ice cream & shopping) — 7 minute walk• New Public Beach Access (across from Café 30A) — 10-minute stroll• Hokulia Shave Ice - 7 minute bike ride________________________________________Resort Amenities Out Your Back Door• 2 Community Swimming Pools• 2 Private Tennis & Pickleball Courts• 3 Bikes included in Rental• Brand new outdoor grill ________________________________________Explore the AreaThree bikes are included in your stay! You are minutes from Seaside, Greenway Station, The Big Chill, Watercolor, Publix, Cumberland Farms, and more. Rent standup paddle boards, kayaks or golf cart to explore the Cassine Garden trails or Point Washington State Forest. Don't want to get stuck in 30A traffic? No problem here - nearby restaurants include Boggy Boys Pizzeria, Angelina's Pizzeria & Pasta, Local Cantina, Perfect Pig Seagrove or Watercolor, Canopy Road Cafe, Cafe Thiry-A, Seagrove Market Cafe, Steamboat Grill, Pecan Jack's, Turbo Coffee and more. Book Luce Del Sol and start your 30A tradition.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS :Master Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - Queen sized bed, shared bathroomBunk Room - Twin over twin bunk bed with trundle, shared bathroomHouse Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**AREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
